decision.reason: The private repository is explicitly described as a converted divergence from Intel's NPU Acceleration Library. Its Casey-side lineage contains direct edits, but those edits are mixed with Intel-origin source, imported feature branches, generated documentation, history snapshots, vendored node_modules, maintenance pins, and unsupported quality claims.

public_archive.description: [ARCHIVED public fork] superseded by private intel-npu-acceleration-library

upstream_graph.count_warning: Ahead-by is a Git-history count, not an originality or accomplishment count.

observed_casey_side_commits.observed_value: Adds input validation and robustness changes around active SDPA paths while also creating historical snapshots. The active code remains Intel-origin and carries Intel copyright headers.
Large mixed change touching setup material, generated documentation, history records and active files. Commit granularity is too poor for recruiter-grade authorship claims.
Adds a 150-line quantization test under .history rather than the active test tree.
Pins urllib3 in dev_requirements.txt; the same commit object exists in Intel's repository history object store.

observed_casey_side_commits.message: docs(quality): Universal Chunk-Power Quality Maximization (Remote Edit)
observed_casey_side_commits.observed_value: Adds QUALITY_ASSURANCE_MANIFEST.md with claims including MAXIMIZED & VERIFIED, zero-bottleneck execution, and an Exascale 900+ sweep while also stating MACBOOK-NATIVE simulation.

observed_casey_side_commits.message: ci: migrate to public runner team reusable workflow
observed_casey_side_commits.observed_value: Adds a 14-line GlacierEQ reusable CI workflow wrapper after the upstream/private lineage merge.

imported_history_boundary.rule: Merge authorship does not transfer authorship of the imported branch implementation to GlacierEQ.

promotion_gate.next_action: Extract the candidate Casey-authored SDPA robustness delta as a minimal patch against the archived Intel base and verify it independently.
requires: hardware or explicitly labeled simulation boundary
removal or quarantine of unsupported QA claims
proof that imported branch code is not counted as Casey authorship
